verdict.rationale: The axis applies because bizfile is an account-gated filing portal. The docs confirm that entity-linked "User Access" controls who may file and will be required for Statements of Information from August 1, 2026. However, nothing in the pack describes how users sign in: no credential-plus-MFA method is documented, and the pack neither confirms nor rules out biometric liveness, in-person verification, or a mailed PIN. Our probe also could not inspect the portal, because it sits behind bot management.
